verdict.rationale: OpenCode ships a documented headless server (`opencode serve`) exposing an OpenAPI endpoint, confirmed live via probe (opencode-probe-3), plus a type-safe JS/TS SDK for programmatic control, and its CLI supports non-interactive scripted use (`opencode run`). missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of SDK/API usage in production, and no evidence of versioning/stability guarantees or broader language SDK support beyond JS/TS.
